figures.shows: ALMA band 6 continuum image of a 20 by 20 arcsec field centred on the GRB 090423 host position with 1-sigma contours at 11 microJy per beam, plus a Spitzer/IRAC 3.6 micron image of the same field; no emission is detected at the host position in either.
readable_values: approx. ALMA contour step 1 sigma = 11 microJy per beam
approx. field size 20 arcsec by 20 arcsec
figures.caption_quote: Contours are in steps of 1σ = 11 µJy beam−1 starting at ±2σ (solid: positive; dashed: negative). No millimeter emission is detected at the location of the host galaxy.

figures.shows: Flux density limits for the GRB 090423 host in HST, Spitzer, ALMA and ATCA bands, compared with shifted SED templates (Arp 220, M 82, I Zw 18, GRB 980425 host, Sd template, L_IR = 3e10 Lsun template), in observed frame (left) and rest-frame luminosity density (right), with additional GRB host and LAE comparison points on the right.
figures.validation_check: Compares the ALMA, HST and Spitzer non-detection limits against template SEDs to show which templates the limits exclude.
readable_values: approx. ALMA limit about 0.01 mJy (about 10 microJy) at about 1300 micrometres observed
approx. Spitzer/IRAC limit near 0.05 microJy at 3.6 micrometres observed
approx. Arp 220 template peak near 50 mJy scaled at about 800 micrometres
figures.caption_quote: For the Arp 220 template the ALMA non-detection places a stronger constraint on the SED than the HST and Spitzer limits, while for the starburst templates the limits are comparable.

figures.shows: Integrated IR luminosities and obscured SFRs of high-redshift galaxies with spectroscopic z above about 4 from ALMA and other millimetre telescopes, including the GRB 090423 host upper limit at z = 8.23, compared with SMGs, LBGs and LAEs.
readable_values: approx. GRB 090423 host upper limit SFR_IR about 5 solar masses per year at z = 8.23
approx. SPT-S J034640-5205.1 L_IR about 3e13 solar luminosities at z about 5.65
approx. BRI1202-0725 LAE-2 L_IR about 1.6e12 solar luminosities at z about 4.7
figures.caption_quote: Integrated IR luminosities and inferred obscured star formation rates (SFRIR = 4.5× 10−44 LIR M⊙yr−1; Kennicutt 1998) of galaxies with spectroscopic redshifts of z ≳4 observed with ALMA and other millimeter telescopes
